text: HbA1c remains high with frequent urination and uncontrolled fasting sugar.
Diabetic follow-up notes hyperglycemia and numbness in the feet.
Serial readings confirm elevated blood pressure with headache and salt restriction advice.
Known hypertension with uncontrolled systolic values despite regular tablets.
Creatinine and urea are raised with reduced eGFR, consistent with kidney disease.
Renal impairment is noted with swelling and abnormal kidney function tests.
Elevated bilirubin and transaminases suggest ongoing liver disease.
Fatty liver with raised ALT and abstinence counseling is documented.
Low hemoglobin with weakness and pallor indicates anemia.
CBC confirms anemia with low haemoglobin and fatigue.
Lipid profile shows high LDL and triglycerides, supporting high cholesterol.
Dyslipidemia follow-up notes persistent high cholesterol above goal.
High TSH with tiredness and weight gain points to thyroid disorder.
Abnormal thyroid profile with tremor and palpitations suggests thyroid disorder.
Epigastric burning after meals and reflux symptoms are consistent with gastritis.
Acidity and upper abdominal pain improved with proton pump inhibitor, likely gastritis.
